Software Developer while continuously learning and delivering high-quality solutions.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Frontend & UI: React.js, React Hooks, HTML5, CSS3, Responsive Design, Flexbox, CSS Grid
Backend & Data: Node.js, Firebase Firestore, REST APIs, JSON
Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Dart
Tools: Git, GitHub, npm, VS Code
PROJECTS
AuraTrack Live Demo: https://mental-health-tracker-ekyf.vercel.app/
React.js, Node.js, Firebase

• Built a full-stack mental health tracker featuring secure authentication, mood analytics, and interactive journaling.

• Integrated Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and AI-based mood detection to deliver personalized, real-time insights.

• Developed AuraBot, an AI chatbot that offers mental wellness guidance, answers user queries, and provides supportive
conversations through AI integration.

• Developed a responsive web platform to showcase and organize downloadable browser and Android games in one place.

• Implemented categorized game listings, interactive UI, and direct game/download access for a seamless user experience.
DevDash Live Demo: https://ichigoxbankai.github.io/devdash/ React.js, JavaScript, AI

• Built a developer productivity dashboard featuring GitHub profile analytics, weather updates, digital clock, calendar,
Pomodoro timer, notes, and task management.

• Integrated external APIs to display real-time GitHub statistics and weather information.
FolderLens Live Demo: https://folder-lens.vercel.app/ JS, Ai, Chrome Extension

• Built a Chrome extension that identifies matching product images and locates their corresponding stored folder.

• Developed an AI-powered image-matching workflow connecting the browser extension, storage dashboard, and backend.
